system.description:
Also at 3rd level, you gain the ability to cast a damaging cantrip through a melee weapon attack. Cantrips which require a melee weapon to cast, such as @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.yejddmd8hnr5maa0]{Thunderstrike} are not eligible for this ability.

Make a melee spell attack with your weapon. On a successful attack you deal the cantrip’s damage, the weapon’s damage, and your spellcasting ability modifier to your target. @UUID[Compendium.a5e-martial-artistry.class-features.Item.dJv6dpK5cvhuVfGb]{Empowered Casting} does not apply to cantrips used in this way.
